scope: 2025 Rhode Island General Assembly members; the site displays an entry only when name, chamber, and district match a 2026 candidate.
methodology: RIEP reproduces organization-specific scores only when the publishing organization provides a legislator-specific result and a source can be linked. Scores from different organizations are not combined, normalized, ranked, or converted into an RIEP score. The 2025 League scorecard is currently the newest statewide Rhode Island legislative scorecard located in this audit that publishes a numerical score for substantially every member of both chambers.

research_audit.organization: Rhode Island League of Cities and Towns
research_audit.reason: Current statewide scorecard with explicit legislator-by-legislator numerical scores for both chambers.
Current and useful voting record, but ACLU of Rhode Island presents selected roll-call votes rather than an overall legislator score. RIEP will not manufacture an ACLU score from those votes.

The state legislative scorecard page located in this audit currently surfaces 2021-2022. It is retained as a research source but excluded from the current 2026 candidate rating display because of age.

research_audit.organization: Rhode Island Center for Freedom & Prosperity
research_audit.latest_reviewed: Rhode Island Freedom Index / interactive scorecard
research_audit.reason: The Center publishes an ideologically framed Freedom Index, but the current public pages located in this audit point to older scorecard cycles rather than a verified 2025-2026 statewide legislator table. RIEP does not substitute an old score for a current one.
